CT CHEST
CLINICAL INDICATION: Renal colic; CT urogram with lung bases.
TECHNIQUE: Axial CT, 1.25 mm reconstructions.
FINDINGS: Heart size normal. No pleural or pericardial effusion. There is a solid noncalcified nodule in the lingula measuring 3 x 2 mm. This is the only pulmonary nodule.
IMPRESSION: Incidental solid noncalcified nodule in the lingula.
